name: OPAL Assets - Bullet-Proof Daily AUM Cohort Tracking
description: Andrew-commissioned macro-project (2026-07-12): bullet-proof DAILY tracking of all 14 Opal AUM cohorts into ONE canonical daily DynamoDB bucket (one row per cohort per day; row shape {cohort, source_master(s), value, as_of, state}), plus per-partner true ETF ownership. PIT-snapshot pattern (retire the bd transaction engine as the AUM source for this surface); each cohort carries its OWN-field as_of and an explicit state (fresh|rolled_forward|missing) so stale/absent cohorts are visible, never silently rolled forward or smeared into a cross-partner as_of. A CONVERGENCE of six already-daily sources + one new Schwab-BD 08335338 PIT pull (both-masters-dedup, D1=SPLIT). Strictly internal.
